Subject: Release governance: action grid + fallbacks

Team,

We need to lock the governance around the coming release for Stratus Health — specifically an "action grid" that maps owners to playbook steps and explicit fallback/rollback triggers. Claire (Stratus) is copying in case they need to align on enablement timing.

Asks:
- Chloe: can you confirm final go/no-go criteria from an enablement/training perspective?
- Laura: who owns the enablement materials and the customer-facing quickstart?
- Rishi: we need explicit rollback triggers and canary thresholds from SRE/ops.

I've attached a starter action grid (enablement_action_grid.xlsx) and a draft rollback playbook (rollback_playbook-v1.pdf). Please update the grid and reply with owners by EOD Wed 5/6.

High-level constraints:
- Soft launch (customer-facing canary) scheduled week of 5/25; full rollout target 6/1.
- Any P1 regression in inference latencies > 2x baseline or error rate spike >1% triggers rollback unless mitigations in <30min.

Thanks,
Ben

--
Ben Carter
Head of Product Operations
Redwood Inference
Attachments: enablement_action_grid.xlsx (spreadsheet), rollback_playbook-v1.pdf (pdf)

Ben — thanks for the kickoff.

Quick answers and proposals:
- Go/no-go from enablement: training completion for CS enablement cohort (5 people) + published quickstart doc + two recorded demos. If those three are done I consider enablement green.
- I will take ownership of the quickstart doc and coordinate recordings; Laura can be listed as co-owner for customer-facing comms. I'll update the action grid.
- Timeline comment: pushing customer canary back by one week to 6/1 gives us breathing room for doc QA; proposal: internal canary 5/25 (alpha customers only), public canary 6/1.

Open question for Rishi: can we get a short list of measurable rollback signals you want in the grid (latency percentile thresholds, error budgets, tail latency, memory OOMs)?

I will update the doc by EOD and flag any resourcing gaps.

-Chloe

Thanks — quick SRE inputs:

Rollback signals (we'll add to the grid):
- 95th p90/p95 latency > 2x baseline for > 10 minutes
- Error rate (5m window) > 1% above baseline
- Token generation failures (500s) > 0.5% in 5m window
- Any OOMs or sustained GPU memory pressure > 85% for 5m

Canary strategy:
- Internal canary 5/25 (10% of live traffic from test orgs)
- Public canary 6/1 (25% traffic for 24h)
- Full rollout 6/8 (if metrics stable)

Fallbacks:
- Auto-fallback to model-v1.7-quant if latency > threshold while we investigate
- Full rollback only if fallback doesn't reduce error/latency within 30 minutes

I'll update the rollback_playbook-v1.pdf with these signal thresholds and add runbook steps for on-call. Good to confirm timelines today so we can schedule dry run with Stratus.

-Rishi
